name: attention_agent_clear
description: Clear agent-owned attention; use when done with a topic or before changing context.

name: attention_agent_read
description:
Read agent-owned attention (single spotlight); call before `attention_agent_set`/`clear`
to avoid unnecessary spotlight churn.

name: attention_agent_set
description:
Set agent-owned attention to one object; call before explanations/edits so the user can
follow the agent in real time.

name: attention_human_read
description:
Read human-owned attention from live TUI state; call early in a turn, then localize with
`diagram_get_slice` and `object_read`.

name: diagram_apply_ops
description:
Apply structured diagram ops gated by `base_rev`; prefer `diagram_propose_ops` first, then
refresh with `diagram_diff`.

section_id.description: Omit or null to detach from all sections.

header.description: When present, replaces the block header (`null` clears it).
When present, replaces the section header (`null` clears it).

McpSeqSectionAddKind.description: Write-only section kinds for `seq_add_section` (main is created by `seq_add_block`).

name: diagram_create_from_mermaid
description:
Create a diagram from raw Mermaid; use to bootstrap a session, then continue with
`diagram_open`/`diagram_stat`.

diagram_id.description: Optional explicit diagram id to use; when omitted a unique id is allocated.

make_active.description: When true (default), sets the created diagram as active.

name.description: Optional display name; defaults to the chosen diagram id.

name: diagram_current
description:
Get the active diagram id (`null` when unset); check this before deciding whether to call
`diagram_open`, then continue with `diagram_stat`/`diagram_get_slice`.

name: diagram_delete
description: Remove a diagram by id and retarget active diagram when needed.

name: diagram_diff
description:
Get diagram delta since a revision; default refresh step after `diagram_apply_ops` or
external changes.

name: diagram_get_ast
description: Read full diagram AST for id/label resolution; prefer this over session-file reads.

name: diagram_get_slice
description:
Get deterministic local neighborhood around an `object_ref`; primary probe tool after
attention/selection or search hits.

name: diagram_list
description:
List diagrams in the current session; start here, then call `diagram_current` or
`diagram_open` (bootstrap with `diagram_create_from_mermaid` if empty).

name: diagram_open
description:
Set the active diagram default for diagram-scoped tools; typically follows `diagram_list`
or `diagram_create_from_mermaid`.

name: diagram_propose_ops
description:
Validate ops against `base_rev` and return predicted delta without mutation; use immediately
before `diagram_apply_ops` for safe human-agent collaboration.

section_id.description: Omit or null to detach from all sections.

header.description: When present, replaces the block header (`null` clears it).
When present, replaces the section header (`null` clears it).

McpSeqSectionAddKind.description: Write-only section kinds for `seq_add_section` (main is created by `seq_add_block`).

name: diagram_read
description:
Read canonical Mermaid snapshot of current diagram AST; use for export/review and
debugging, not as the default probe.

name: diagram_render_text
description:
Render diagram as deterministic text (Unicode allowed); use for human-readable snapshots
and review, then return to `diagram_stat`/`diagram_get_slice` for targeted reasoning.

name: diagram_replace_from_mermaid
description:
Replace an existing diagram's content from Mermaid while reconciling stable object ids
from the current AST (messages, blocks, nodes, edges). Prefer structure ops for local
edits; use this for bulk rewrites that should keep identity when fingerprints match.

mermaid.description: Replacement Mermaid source; kind must match the existing diagram.

dropped.description: Object ids present before replace but not after (dropped/unmatched).

newly_allocated.description: Object ids present after replace but not before (new allocations).

preserved.description: Object ids present both before and after replace.

dangling_xref_ids.description: XRef ids that are dangling after the replace (from, to, or both).

name: diagram_stat
description:
Get a compact diagram digest (rev + counts + key names); use as the default first read
before `diagram_get_slice`, typed queries, or mutation planning.

name: flow_cycles
description: Detect flowchart cycles (returns node ref cycles); use for risk checks before edits.

name: flow_dead_ends
description:
List terminal flowchart nodes (returns refs); combine with `flow_unreachable` to identify
dead routes.

name: flow_degrees
description:
Compute flow fan-in/fan-out degrees (returns refs + counts); use to identify hubs and
bottlenecks before refactoring.

name: flow_paths
description:
Find bounded paths between two flow nodes (returns ref paths); use after
`flow_reachable`/`object_read` to explain alternatives.

name: flow_reachable
description:
List flow nodes reachable from a node id (returns refs); pair with `flow_paths` and
`diagram_get_slice` for local traversal.

name: flow_unreachable
description:
List nodes unreachable from start nodes (returns refs); use for cleanup/TODO mapping and
follow with `diagram_get_slice`.

name: follow_ai_read
description:
Read follow-AI mode (`true` means TUI tracks agent spotlight); check this before
spotlight-heavy guidance, and pair with `follow_ai_set` when handing off control.

name: follow_ai_set
description:
Set follow-AI mode (`true` to track agent spotlight in TUI); use with `attention_agent_set`
for guided handoff.

name: object_read
description: Read concrete object fields by ref; use this as evidence before answering.

name: route_find
description:
Find cross-diagram routes between two object refs; combine with `xref_neighbors` and
`diagram_get_slice` for explain-and-refine flows.

name: selection_read
description:
Read the shared multi-selection working set as canonical `object_ref`s; call after
`attention_human_read` and before `object_read` or `selection_update`.

name: selection_update
description:
Update shared multi-selection (`replace`/`add`/`remove`); use to mark a temporary working
set for discussion or edits.

name: seq_messages
description:
List sequence messages (returns refs) with optional filters; good starting point before
`seq_trace` or targeted mutation planning.

name: seq_search
description:
Search sequence messages by substring/regex (returns refs); typically feed results into
`object_read`, `seq_trace`, or attention/selection updates.

name: seq_trace
description:
Trace sequence message order before/after a message id (returns refs); use for timeline
explanations and local impact checks.

name: view_read_state
description:
Read UI view state (active diagram, scroll, panes); use with
`attention_human_read`/`attention_agent_read` for orientation without mutating focus.

name: walkthrough_apply_ops
description: Apply walkthrough ops using `base_rev` from `walkthrough_stat`; on conflict, refresh and retry.

name: walkthrough_current
description:
Get the active walkthrough id (`null` when unset); call after `walkthrough_list` and
before `walkthrough_open`/`walkthrough_read`.

name: walkthrough_diff
description: Read walkthrough delta since a revision; call after mutations to verify applied changes.

name: walkthrough_get_node
description:
Get one walkthrough node by id; use for drill-down after `walkthrough_list` or
`walkthrough_read`.

name: walkthrough_list
description:
List walkthroughs in the current session; start here, then `walkthrough_open`,
`walkthrough_stat`, or `walkthrough_read`.

name: walkthrough_open
description:
Set the active walkthrough default for walkthrough-scoped tools; usually after
`walkthrough_list`.

name: walkthrough_read
description:
Read a full walkthrough (nodes/edges/refs); call after `walkthrough_stat` when you need
complete node/edge detail, and before targeted `walkthrough_get_node`.

name: walkthrough_render_text
description:
Render walkthrough text for human-readable sharing/export; prefer
`walkthrough_stat`/`walkthrough_read` for machine reasoning and follow-up edits.

name: walkthrough_stat
description: Read current walkthrough revision and counts; call before walkthrough mutations.

name: xref_add
description:
Add a cross-diagram xref; use to persist discovered relationships from route/trace analysis
and walkthrough work.

name: xref_list
description:
List session xrefs (including dangling filters); use to audit mappings before route/search
exploration or cleanup.

name: xref_neighbors
description:
List xref-neighbor objects connected to an `object_ref`; useful probe step after
`attention_human_read` or `route_find`.

name: xref_remove
description: Remove an xref by id; typically follows `xref_list` review or dangling cleanup.
